title: N-able security advisory (AV26-1143)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1143 Date: November 12, 2026 As of November 10, 2026, N-able is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: N-central Prior to 2026.4.1.26 Open-source reporting indicates that CVE-2026-125883 is exploited in the wild. The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available.
